description: Measures and trains AI fluency from your real Claude Code sessions — local-first, aggregate-only sync

plugins.name: ai-fluency
plugins.description: Captures how you actually use Claude Code and scores 7 AI-fluency behaviors — context-setting, plan-first, verification, diagnose-vs-retry, understanding-seeking, scope discipline, iteration discipline. Scores run entirely on-device. Only aggregate turn scores sync to your dashboard; raw prompts never leave your machine.
